article.body_preview:
DHAKA, Jan 16, 2023 (BSS) - President of Dhaka Chamber of Commerce & Industry (DCCI) Barrister Md. Sameer Sattar today said that the just unveiled Monetary Policy Statements (MPS) for the January-June period of FY23 would help both the private and financial sector to turn around.

He said this MPS is primarily aimed at curbing inflation and to stabilize the foreign exchange reserve.

Sameer said this in the wake of the declared Monetary Policy for the January-June period of 2023 given yesterday
